---
name: Bug report
about: Something in the engine, a field pack, or the skill works incorrectly
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**What happened**
A clear description of the incorrect behavior.

**What you expected**
What should have happened instead.

**Where it lives**
Which file(s) or pipeline stage are involved (e.g. `engine/scoring.md`,
the Verifier stage, the skill's `references/roles/critic.md`)?

**Run context (if a pipeline run was involved)**
Mode (batch discovery / score-my-idea), field pack, and the stage where
it went wrong. Attach or paste the relevant run records if you can share
them — the blackboard record is the fastest route to a diagnosis.

**Environment**
Which agent product and model ran it (e.g. Muse on muse.ai, model
name/version if known)?
